kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
يستشهدون (form X)
# يَسْتَشْهِدُونَ (yastašhidūna) /jas.taʃ.hi.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
# يُسْتَشْهَدُونَ (yustašhadūna) /jus.taʃ.ha.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada) and اُسْتُشْهِدَ (ustušhida)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
